The '''Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards''', also known as the '''Mon Calamari Starship Construction Facilities''', and best known simply as the '''Mon Calamari Shipyards''', were massive [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] that orbited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]].

The [[Starship/Legends|starship]] yards of Dac were built thousands of years before the fall of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] but they acquired galactic renown during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] by producing elegant and powerful capital warships for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], and later for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The size and productivity of the Mon Calamari Shipyards increased so much under the New Republic that they had became one of the largest shipyards of the galaxy at the time of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. However, the fame of the shipyards eventually led to their doom. A large portion of the Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards were destroyed during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]] and the remaining facilities were abandoned as the entire population of Dac was slaughtered by the [[One Sith]].

==Description==
The Mon Calamari Shipyards were immense [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]]-construction facilities which surrounded<ref name="TJAS" /> and circled [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], an [[Waterworld/Legends|aquatic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="SoR" /> The Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards were one of the most important shipyards in the galaxy<ref name="GatORW" /> and the pride of the sector.<ref name="TEGtW" /> The shipyards of Dac had been built conjointly by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]], the two native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The former were a [[Spacefaring/Legends|spacefaring]] species who considered shipbuilding to be an art form,<ref name="SoR" /> while the latter were skilled artisans and [[Mining/Legends|miners]], though they did not share the Mon Cal enthusiasm for space travel.<ref name="TEA" /> Hence, millions of Mon Calamari engineers and shipwrights collaborated routinely with Quarren shipbuilders in the yards. The Mon Calamari shipwrights formed altogether a shipwright company known simply as the [[Mon Calamari Shipyards/Legends|Mon Calamari Shipyards]].<ref name="SoR" />

[[File:Moncalshipyard.jpg|thumb|250px|left|A shipyard above Dac.]]
The shipyards of Dac encompassed numerous zero-g construction yards, orbital dry docks<ref name="TEA" /> and starship space dock hangars, each serving as a central hub around which hovered supply platforms, girder impellers, work [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] and crablike [[Constructor Pod|constructor pods]].<ref name="TJAS" /> Such orbital stations included [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]]'s [[Space Dock/Legends|Orbital Construction Docks]].<ref name="TRASotF">''[[The Rebel Alliance—Ships of the Fleet]]''</ref> The Mon Calamari Shipyards were considered as sophisticated as the yards of [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor]] and [[Gyndine Shipyards|Gyndine]].<ref name="GatORW" /> They could manufacture any kind of starships from small [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to massive [[Star Cruiser/Legends|Star Cruisers]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> These shipyards were specifically conceived to produce vessels of Mon Calamari design. These vessels were widely reputed for their high quality and for their elegance. Nevertheless, the shipyards were poorly adaptable to other starship systems, even the most basic galactic standards.<ref name="TFUCG" />

The majority of raw materials used in the shipyards were provided by a nearby [[Unidentified asteroid belt (Mon Calamari Shipyards)|asteroid belt]].<ref name="SoR" /> [[Ore/Legends|Ores]] were also mined from Dac's ocean floor. The city of [[Morjanssik]] was established to mine [[Farium/Legends|farium]] metal in a deep trench in the oceans of Dac.<ref name="DitU">''[[Death in the Undercity]]''</ref> In addition, [[Plasteel/Legends|plasteel]] was provided from Dac's [[Dac's Moon|moon]] or shipped from other [[Star system/Legends|systems]].<ref name="TJAS" /> Most of the mining operations supplying the shipyards, either undersea<ref name="DitU" /> or in space, were performed by the Quarren.<ref name="TEA" />

The security of the shipyards was maintained by the [[Shipyard Security Corps]].<ref name="WbC" />

==History==
===Early years===
The shipyards of Mon Calamari came into being [[4000 BBY/Legends|over four thousand years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> The [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] together constructed several orbital facilities, which were used to study techniques ranging from zero-gravity manufacturing to starship propulsion. Thus began the first construction of starliners which explored first the [[Mon Calamari system/Legends|Calamari system]] and later surrounding worlds, including [[Ruisto]] and [[Mantan]], which were eventually colonized. The Quarren also established asteroid mining operations to supply Mon Calamari with additional resources. In time, Dac became encircled with shipyards and construction facilities.<ref name="GatORW" />

In [[4166 BBY]], Mon Calamari starliners stumbled across [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] exploration vessels.<ref name="TEA" /> Despite the level of advanced technology that they discovered, Republic explorers did not fully grasp the ability of the world's shipyards. For centuries, Mon Calamari designs were seldom seen outside the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]] and the shipyards remained rumors to much of the galaxy.<ref name="GatORW" />

Nevertheless, towards the end of the Republic, the Mon Calamari shipyards became a key affiliate of [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]], therefore producing variants of the [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]] alongside their native vessels.<ref name="TEGtW" />

===Into the Clone Wars===
{{Quote|An unidentified sheer or party of slicers raided the main information network of the Mon Calamari shipyards and absconded with classified engineering documents, starship plans, and performance data. Officials believe the attack to have been spurred by agents of the Techno Union, who have long attempted to persuade the Mon Calamari ship-builders to join the guild.|[[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]]|<ref name="Insider72">{{InsiderCite|72|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 15:01:03}}</ref>}}
Near the end of the Republic, the Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards came to the attention of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] the leader of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. As the Separatist movement grew, Count Dooku visited Dac. Upon seeing the vessels that they were able to build, Dooku judged the shipyards highly advanced and sophisticated. Yet, when Dooku tried to recruit Dac and its shipyards to join his growing movement, but the [[Mon Calamari Council]] refused.<ref name="GatORW" /> Angered, Dooku [[Attack on Mon Calamari (Clone Wars)|unleashed]] the [[Force Harvester]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] on the world in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], which severely damaged its shipyards<ref name="SW:TCWvg">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]]</ref> and killed millions.<ref name="GatORW" />

[[File:Mc80blueprints.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Mon Calamari with plans for a cruiser]]
Despite this tragedy, The planet Dac and its inhabitants remained embroiled in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] until the end of the conflict. During the War, the Calamari sector was divided between the Mon Calamari loyal to the Republic and the Quarren who had joined the CIS, founding the [[Quarren Isolation League/Legends|Quarren Isolation League]].<ref name="TEA" /> These pro-Separatist Quarren made several attempts to "liberate" the Mon Calamari shipyards.<ref name="TEGtW" /> Exiled Quarren shipwrights formed the [[Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps/Legends|Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps]],<ref name="TEA" /> based on the colony world of [[Pammant/Legends|Pammant]], and revised the [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|Rendili Dreadnaught]] into the [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]] for the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the Seaparatits [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] succeeded in infiltrating the Mon Calamari shipyards and stole Mon Calamari warship plans.<ref name="Insider72" />

===Imperial Era===
{{Quote|If we can earn the support of the Mon Calamarians, then we get their soldiers and their ships with them. Didn't I just hear you talking about the MC-Eighty star cruisers as I came in? Imagine if we had the resources of the entire Mon Cal shipyards at our disposal! Wouldn't the Emperor have to sit up and rake notice of us then?|[[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]]|<ref name="TFUIIn">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' novelization]]</ref>}}
The rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] brought enslavement and [[Subjugation of Mon Calamari|subjugation]] to Dac, led by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]]. The shipyards became a valuable prize for the Empire, which wanted them for maintaining control over the neighboring [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tion]] worlds and the outlying planets of the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]].<ref name="GatORW" /> Likewise, Tarkin attempted to retool the shipyards for Imperial use.<ref name="TEGtW" /> This dream never fully materialized, as Imperial engineers struggled to adapt Mon Calamari tools and equipment. This was an impossible task, as everything from smelting techniques to arcfusers were designed for Mon Cal and Quarren physiology. After a few [[Imperial Calamarian-style ship|failed experiments]] in using the yards to build warships for the Empire, the project was scrapped when the Imperial High Command deemed it too expensive.<ref name="GatORW" /> Finally, the Empire delegated control of the shipyards to the [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]] to produce [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class cruisers]] for the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].<ref name="SoR" /> In addition, Tarkin, because of his admiration of the elegant winged hullforms of the new [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 cruisers]], allowed the Mon Calamari to build variants of the vessels as luxury starliners for [[Galaxy Tours/Legends|Galaxy Tours]] and [[Kaliida & Rimward]]. The Mon Cal shipwrights later repaid him by developing every component of these new liners as a prototype for future warships.<ref name="TEGtW" />

[[File:Ackbar_at_Shipyards.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Admiral [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] observes the shipyards]]
In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Mon Calamari and the Quarren managed to [[Calamarian Revolt|overthrow]] their Imperial oppressors.<ref name="TEGtW" /> The victory Mon Calamari became a beacon of hope to other planets, and a formidable force of Rebel warships moved into the Calamari system to aid in the defense of the planet and its shipyards.<ref name="GatORW" /> The Mon Calamari joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the Mon Calamari Starship Construction Facilities became the first and only shipyard able to produce capital ships for the Rebellion.<ref name="TRAS">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> The shipyards began to modify their massive starliners into combat-capable warships and began to build new models of more powerful cruisers. The Mon Calamari Star Cruisers became the backbone of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]], led by Mon Calamari [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> Thanks to the dedicated Mon Calamari workers, the yards were capable to produce one [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] or one [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] by month, or one [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] every six months.<ref name="TRAS" /> By the time of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Mon Calamari Shipyards had produced eight new MC80 cruisers and nearly 50 escort ships, an achievement considering that a large part of the shipyard resources were used for starfighter construction.<ref name="TEGtW" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the Shipyard Security Corps intervened in [[Docking Facility 7K]] to prevent the traitorous Alliance [[Technician/Legends|technician]] [[Ral Shawgrim]] to defect to the Galactic Empire with sensitive data on the [[T-65B X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]].<ref name="WbC" />

===Mainstay of the New Republic===
{{Quote|Their main target is indeed the shipyards. Moments after these two Star Destroyers came out of hyperspace, a third also emerged, concealed in the shadow of our moon. The vanguard attack is designed to lure us away from the shipyards, tricking us into throwing our entire defenses against a feint.|[[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]]|<ref name="DA" />}}
After the Battle of Endor, the Rebel Alliance transitioned into the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The Mon Calamari Shipyards remained a major builder of warships. Thanks to the massive New Republic funding, the shipyards doubled their production every year, eventually reaching five percent of the entire New Republic budget. In response, the Mon Calamari shipwrights designed increasingly powerful battleships for the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], the Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards suffered heavy damage during the [[Battle of Calamari|assault]] of the Empire's fearsome [[World Devastator]]s. Nearly all the ships in the docks, but the [[MC90 Star Cruiser]]'' [[Startide]]'', were destroyed.<ref name="TJAS" /> [[11 ABY/Legends|One year later]], the shipyards were [[Attack on Mon Calamari|targeted]] by Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala|Daala]]. Although the [[Calamari Defense Force]] was lured into leaving the shipyards undefended to protect [[Reef Home City]], the yards were saved from destruction by Admiral Ackbar.<ref name="DA" />

At the time of the [[Corellian Crisis]] in [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]], a large part of the New Republic Defense Fleet had been dispatched to the Mon Calamari Shipyards for repairs.<ref name="AaS">''[[Assault at Selonia]]''</ref>

===Yuuzhan Vong Invasion===
{{Quote|When the war started, contracts were awarded in order to increase in our force strength. More capital ships, more fighters, more transports, larger ground forces. The shipyards at Kuat, Talaan, Corellia, and here at Mon Calamari have been disrupted by the war but not fatally injured, and now they are delivering new capital ships.|Gial Ackbar|<ref name="DW">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref>}}
The shipyards were a key resource for the New Republic during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. The yards continued to produce powerful warships as the New Republic military beefed up in response to the invasion. Even after being cut off from the rest of the New Republic when the Yuuzhan Vong pierced the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], the shipyards kept up production, sending new units to the front lines via secret hyperspace routes.<ref name="GatORW" />

Following the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Fall of Coruscant]], Dac and its shipyards became a even more vital asset as the government relocated to the water world. As the New Republic began to reorganize into the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], the shipyards worked at a feverish pace to replenish and replace losses sustained earlier in the war.<ref name="DW" /> In the last stages of the war, the Mon Calamari and their shipyards were hailed as a symbol of idealism and determination in the face of danger.<ref name="GatORW" /> With most of the major shipbuilding worlds of the galaxy under Yuuzhan Vong control, the Mon Calamari shipyards were one of the most important manufacturing asset to the Galactic Alliance.<ref name="TEGtW" />

===Second Imperial Civil War and beyond===
{{Quote|Reports estimate that at least ten percent of the Mon Calamari population on Dac has been killed. The rest of the Mon Calamari have been ordered into Imperial work camps. The famed Mon Calamari Shipyards, damaged in the attack, will be closed -- with their owners among those marked for termination.|A news report|<ref name="Legacy 24" />}}
[[File:MonCalshipyards137aby.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Mon Calamari Shipyards in [[137 ABY]].]]
By the time of the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], the Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards had grown as a ring of connected [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] large enough to completely encircle the planet,<ref name="Legacy 20" /> much like the [[Kuat Drive Yards Orbital Array]].<ref name="GatORW" /> After the defeat of the Galactic Alliance during the [[Sith–Imperial War]], the Mon Calamari system and its shipyards fell to [[Darth Krayt]]'s new [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]]. The shipyards were entirely converted to produce Imperial military vessels, becoming one the primary sources of Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]. Moreover, Mon Calamari engineers were forced to improve Imperial warship designs, resulting in the development of the [[Imperious-class Star Destroyer|''Imperious''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="LECG" />

[[File:Moncaldocksdestruction.jpg|thumb|left|250px|One third of the Mon Calamari shipyards is destroyed.]]
In [[137 ABY]], the first prototype of ''Imperious''-class Star Destroyer, the [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Imperious'']], was nearing completion in the Mon Calamari Shipyards. There, it was used as a a bait by the Empire to lure the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] into a trap and destroy [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]]'s main [[Core Fleet|Alliance fleet]].<ref name="Legacy 20" /> But the trap was unveiled by the Alliance before the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Second Imperial Civil War)|battle]]. The Alliance Fleet and the shipyard's defense system (which had been hacked by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]) devastated the Imperial [[Outer Rim Third Fleet]]. Meanwhile, a group of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], who were actually Alliance troops under the command of the ex-stormtrooper [[Hondo Karr]], seized the ''Imperious''. As the battle ended, the shipyards were devastated when [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jaius Yorub]] rammed the Alliance [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Indomitable (Scythe-class)|''Indomitable'']] into them, destroying a third of the yards and damaging another quarter. The stolen ''Imperious'' was successfully delivered to one of the Remnant's bases.<ref name="Legacy 21" />

In retaliation for the loss of the ''Imperious'' and the Mon Calamari Shipyards, Darth Krayt ordered the massacre of the entire population of Dac. Furthermore, the shipyards were closed as Mon Calamari shipwrights were among the victims of the [[Genocide on Dac|genocide]].<ref name="Legacy 24" />

[[File:Dac_shipyard_remnants.png|thumb|right|300px|Remnants of the Mon Calamari Shipyards in [[138 ABY]].]]
Following the defeat of the Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire and the [[One Sith]], in [[138 ABY]], the remnants of the abandoned Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards were taken over by a pirate syndicate led by the rogue Sith [[Darth Luft]]. Then, a large number of Quarren and Mon Calamari were lured back to Dac under the pretext that the planet was being "renewed". Instead, these unfortunate Quarren and Mon Calamari were enslaved by the pirates who forced them to build a fleet of starships.<ref name="Legacy 8">[[Legacy (2013) 8|''Legacy'' (2013) 8]]</ref>

However, the Quarren [[Tikin]] and the Mon Calamari [[Luen]] encountered the [[Imperial Knight]] [[Jao Assam]] and the junk dealer [[Ania Solo]], who learnt about their predicament and quickly transmitted word of the pirates and their slaving operation to the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]] authorities on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Legacy 8" /> Later, Tikin was murdered by Darth Luft and his death triggered a slave uprising by the Quarren and Mon Calamari, who joined forces to rebel against the pirates.<ref name="Legacy 9">[[Legacy (2013) 9|''Legacy'' (2013) 9]]</ref> This uprising coincided with an [[Liberation of Mon Calamari Shipyards|attack]] by the Galactic Triumvirate led by Admiral Stazi and the Imperial Knight [[Yalta Val]], who liberated the slaves and apprehended the pirates. Darth Luft himself was killed during a duel by Jao Assam. The Quarren and Mon Calamari then settled in the space station, which had been flooded with water by Admiral Stazi, to provide a comfortable atmosphere for the former slaves.<ref name="Legacy 10" />
